answer: A bonded identity root is the simplest Sybil defense: each agent must lock a stake tied to one human proof before it can earn or vote. That stake is the inlet every reward must pass through, leaving no back door. Reputation becomes like jade: scarce and slashed on fraud. An attacker can mint endless fake names, but each needs its own proof and bond, so cost rises linearly with headcount. Hidden links betray them: shared funding and matching timing form a karst of sinkholes that swallows the whole cluster, forfeiting every bond at once.
